question: Where is the threefold division of immersion authoritatively taught?
premises: A threefold division has been indicated.
This division is taught in the scripture named Śrīpūrva.
The supreme Lord declared it in the context of determining samāveśa.
inference: Therefore the threefold account of immersion has scriptural authority from the supreme Lord.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the threefoldness is supplied by the surrounding context rather than named in this verse.
plain_english: This threefold division is taught by the supreme Lord in the scripture called Śrīpūrva, in the section that explains immersion.
